visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Exterior of a multi-story residential building with light-colored brick tiles and prominent red metal railings on the balconies. At the ground level, a restaurant entrance features a dark roof, wooden signboards, and white curtains with black ink characters. Potted bonsai plants line the gray pavement in front. (2) The camera moves indoors to a minimalist dining area. Customers in casual attire sit at a light-colored wooden L-shaped counter. A chef in a black t-shirt is visible behind the counter preparing food. The room is brightly lit with warm indoor lighting and features clean white walls and wooden furniture. (3) A transition shows a person with short dark hair and a black t-shirt walking into a second-floor dining room. This space has a traditional aesthetic with large wooden windows, tiled floors, and low wooden tables surrounded by floor cushions. The atmosphere is calm and well-lit by natural light. (4) A series of extreme close-ups showcase various Japanese-style dishes. A thick, breaded pork cutlet is dipped into a dark, viscous sauce. A beef rice bowl is topped with a soft-boiled egg that is broken with a spoon, releasing a vibrant yellow yolk. Various desserts, including ice cream-topped toast and a blue soda float, are presented. (5) The final scene shows a hand holding a soft-serve ice cream cone in front of a blurred restaurant exterior. Large text overlays in Simplified Chinese appear on the screen, providing the restaurant's name and address. The visual rhythm is fast-paced, with frequent cuts between food items.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator begins speaking in Mandarin Chinese with clear, professional articulation. The background music features a bright acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a steady, mid-tempo percussion beat (~115 BPM). The ambient noise floor is extremely clean, indicating a studio-recorded voiceover. (2) The narrator's pitch remains mid-range with friendly variability as he describes the establishment's history and two-story layout. The music maintains its upbeat, rhythmic consistency without any sudden shifts or pauses. There are no notable SFX, keeping the focus entirely on the narration. (3) The narration continues with increased enthusiasm, emphasizing the food portions and textures like the thick pork cutlets. The acoustic guitar textures in the BGM remain consistent. A subtle, high-frequency sound, possibly a faint spoon clink, is occasionally audible beneath the primary audio layers. (4) The voice transitions to a concluding recommendation, inviting viewers to gather with friends. The music volume remains stable throughout the call to action until the final three seconds, where it executes a smooth fade-out as the narration finishes.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce and promote a Japanese-style restaurant named 'Mian Wu Tian Jie' located in an old house near Kaohsiung Station. It highlights the unique architecture, the cozy interior atmosphere, and specifically focuses on the large portion sizes and appetizing visual presentation of their donburi and desserts to attract food enthusiasts.
